# CLAUDE.md — Marketplace Module

Scope: guidance for `vendor/corals/marketplace` only. This is the standalone Composer package `corals/marketplace`, installed here as a **vendor package** (moved from the old dynamic-module location `Corals/modules/Marketplace`). Do not treat instructions in the root project `CLAUDE.md` about `Corals/modules/*` as applying to this folder — this module now follows the vendor-package pattern used by `corals/cms`, `corals/payment`, etc.

## What this module is

`code: corals-marketplace`, namespace `Corals\Modules\Marketplace`, provider `Corals\Modules\Marketplace\MarketplaceServiceProvider`. Manages stores, products, orders, coupons, shipping, and the shopping cart. Depends on (per `composer.json`): `corals/subscriptions`, `corals/payment`, `corals/cms`, `corals/advert`, `corals/referral`, `corals/messaging`, `corals/utility-rating`, `corals/utility-comment`, `corals/utility-wishlist`, `corals/utility-lov`.

## Autoloading note

`corals/marketplace` is **not** a proper Composer dependency of the root project (its packages.laraship.com license is expired, so `composer require`/`update` for it will fail). Instead, its PSR-4 namespace is wired directly into the root project's own `composer.json` `autoload.psr-4`:

```json
"Corals\\Modules\\Marketplace\\": "vendor/corals/marketplace/src"
```

This is regenerated by a plain `composer dump-autoload` (fully offline — no repository contact, no license check). `MarketplaceServiceProvider` is not Laravel-package-auto-discovered (it isn't in `vendor/composer/installed.json`), so it only loads through the DB-driven `Corals\Modules\ModulesServiceProvider` once the `modules` table row for `corals-marketplace` is `enabled=1, installed=1`. That row has been seeded (via `Modules::getModulesSettings()`), currently sitting at `enabled=0, installed=0` — same "discovered but not installed" state as `corals-cms`, `corals-payment`, etc. in this environment. Install/enable it the normal way: Settings → Modules in the admin UI, or `php artisan corals:modules --action=install --type=module --module_name=corals-marketplace`.

If `vendor/corals/marketplace` is ever moved or replaced, re-run `composer dump-autoload` — no other step is needed for autoloading to pick it up.

## Structure

- `src/MarketplaceServiceProvider.php` — extends `Corals\Foundation\Providers\BasePackageServiceProvider`. `registerPackage()` runs only if the `modules` DB row for `corals-marketplace` is `enabled=1, installed=1`; `bootPackage()` same gate. `registerModulesPackages()` always runs on boot and calls `Modules::addModulesPackages('corals/marketplace')` so the Settings module manager can locate `module.json` under `vendor/corals/marketplace`.
- `src/Providers/` — `MarketplaceRouteServiceProvider`, `MarketplaceAuthServiceProvider`, `MarketplaceObserverServiceProvider` (registered from `registerPackage()`).
- `src/Models/` — `Product`, `SKU`, `SKUOption`, `Attribute`, `AttributeSet`, `AttributeOption`, `Category`, `ProductCategory`, `Brand`, `Tag`, `Store`, `Order`, `OrderItem`, `Coupon`, `Shipping`, `ProductShipping`, `Package`, `UserCart`.
- `src/Http/Controllers/` — admin-side controllers (`ProductsController`, `StoresController`, `OrdersController`, `CouponsController`, `ShippingsController`, `AttributesController`, `AttributeSetsController`, `BrandsController`, `CategoriesController`, `TagsController`, `TransactionsController`, `PackagesController`, `SKUController`, `SKUBulkController`, `MarketplaceImportController`, ...) plus public-facing ones (`ShopController`/`ShopPublicController`, `CartController`/`CartPublicController`, `CheckoutController`/`CheckoutPublicController`, `StorePublicController`).
- `src/Classes/` — `ShoppingCart`, `Store` service classes bound as `shoppingcart` / `store` singletons.
- `src/Facades/` — `Marketplace`, `OrderManager`, `Shop`, `ShoppingCart`, `Store`, `Shipping`, `ShippingPackages` (aliased in `registerPackage()`'s `booted()` callback, not via `config/app.php`).
- `src/Hooks/` — `Marketplace` (Actions/Filters registrations), `HasStore` (mixed into `Corals\User\Models\User`).
- `src/Widgets/` — shortcode widgets (`orders`, `products`, `coupons`, `product_categories`, `brand_ratio`, `my_orders`, `my_wishlist`, `my_downloads`, `my_private_pages`, `my_store_orders`, `my_store_products`, `my_store_sales`).
- `src/routes/web.php` — admin routes under `prefix('marketplace')`, `as('marketplace.')`; `src/routes/api.php` — API routes.
- `src/config/marketplace.php`, `src/config/shoppingcart.php` — merged config.
- `src/database/` — migrations/seeders; `src/update-batches/` — versioned upgrade scripts run by `Modules::executeModuleBatches()`.
- `src/Console/Commands/` — `CalculateTopSellers`, `SendAbandonedCartsNotification`, `TransferScheduledPayouts`.

## Working in this module

- Follow `corals/marketplace`'s own `composer.json` (PSR-4 `Corals\Modules\Marketplace\` → `src`) — do not add a second autoload entry in the root project for this namespace.
- Version/require changes belong in `vendor/corals/marketplace/composer.json`, not the root project's.
- `module.json` (`folder: Marketplace`, `load_order: 601`) drives the Settings module manager's install/enable/disable/update UI — it is unrelated to Composer's own package resolution, just to the in-app "Modules" admin screen.
- New admin routes/views/views overrides go through the same `Theme` facade mechanism described in the root `CLAUDE.md`.
